title: Application Settings
description: Manage your account information, application appearance and login session.

blocks.text: The Settings page allows you to view your currently logged-in account, change the application theme and securely log out from HylooSec.

items.title: Open the Sidebar
items.description: Locate the Settings icon in the application sidebar.

items.title: Open Settings
items.description: Click the Settings icon to open the Settings page.

blocks.text: The Settings page displays information about the account currently logged into HylooSec.

items.name: Current User
items.description: Displays the name of the currently logged-in HylooSec user.

items.name: User ID
items.description: Displays the unique User ID of the active account.

blocks.text: HylooSec supports both Dark Mode and Light Mode for a comfortable chatting experience.

items.title: Locate Theme Switch
items.description: Find the theme option inside Settings.

items.title: Choose a Theme
items.description: Select either Dark Mode or Light Mode.

items.title: Theme Applied
items.description: The application updates its appearance immediately.

blocks.text: Use the Logout button to securely end your current HylooSec session.

items.title: Session Closed
items.description: Your current login session ends and you are returned to the Login page.

items.solution: Select the desired theme again. If the issue continues, refresh the application.
Check your internet connection and try again.

items: Always log out when using a shared or public device.
Do not leave your account signed in on devices you do not trust.
Verify the logged-in account before sending sensitive messages.

popup.title: Settings Help
content: Switch between Dark Mode and Light Mode.
Use Logout to securely end your session.
